direction: Keep the existing lightweight, secondary thinking disclosure. Use one shared answer boundary and normal paragraph rhythm instead of stacked block margins and raw empty lines.

references.observation: Official documentation describes an expandable Thinking section above the final response.
Official Deep Research guidance exposes process detail through a Show thinking control.
Implementation reference separates the reasoning trigger/content from the final message response.

reference_limits: References inform disclosure hierarchy. No exact current product pixel measurements are claimed; the 16px and 8px values were chosen and verified against this project's typography and screenshots.
cause: The existing 16px reply boundary plus a first code block's 14px top margin created a 30px gap. Raw pre-wrap thinking text preserved double newlines as whole blank lines.
changes: Reset first and last Markdown child margins so code, text, headings and lists share a 16px answer boundary
Render thinking content through the existing Markdown renderer, retaining its secondary 14px/1.7 typography
Use 8px paragraph gaps inside thinking with 4px top and 8px bottom content padding
motion: Existing HeroUI Disclosure transitions retained; no additional motion.
removed_text: No content removed. Empty-line presentation replaced by paragraph spacing.
review: Local refinement: main-agent visual inspection; no independent reviewer.
visual_checks: Desktop, 390px narrow preview and 200% CSS zoom of the actual Conversation component. Paragraphs remain readable, with no horizontal overflow.
limitations: Local fixture data and actual production components were used. No live provider request or production build was run.
